# Home

[![](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/MakingHistory_Rectangle-icon-1200x800.png "MakingHistory_Rectangle-icon")](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/exhibitions/staten-island-making-history/)

Now On View!

## Staten Island: Making History

Staten Island Making History showcases people, places, and ideas that define and expand understanding of this borough. From Lenapehoking, through the formation of a nation and capital of the world, to the present day — this new exhibition presents rich history through more than one hundred rarely seen objects, photographs, oral histories, artwork, and archival materials in the museum’s collection.

[Learn More](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/exhibitions/staten-island-making-history/)

[![](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Anchoring-HOme-image1-1200x803.jpg "Anchoring-HOme-image1")](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/exhibitions/stephanie-dinkins-anchoring-home/)

New Exhibition Coming Soon

## Stephanie Dinkins: Anchoring Home

Who holds the power to shape the future? In the solo exhibition, Anchoring Home, world-renowned artist Stephanie Dinkins returns to Staten Island inviting your voice to alter projected imagery as it flows through AI processes.

[Learn More](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/exhibitions/stephanie-dinkins-anchoring-home/)

[![Staten Island Museum Interior lobby](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/block-mission.jpg "Staten Island Museum Interior")](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/about/)

About Us

## Curiosity Lives Here

It is the mission of the Staten Island Museum to spark curiosity and generate meaningful shared experiences through natural science, art, and history to deepen understanding of our environment, ourselves, and each other.

[Read More](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/about/)

Rentals

## Host your next event at the Staten Island Museum!

From weddings, cocktail receptions and intimate dinner parties to corporate events and staff retreats, the Staten Island Museum is a unique cultural destination offering flexible spaces to help you create an inspiring and memorable event.

[Learn More](https://www.statenislandmuseum.org/support/rentals/)
